title: Temperature \tau in Contrastive Loss (InfoNCE): · hardest negative
prompt: **Temperature $\tau$ in Contrastive Loss (InfoNCE):** $\mathcal{L} = -\log \frac{\exp(\text{sim}(q, k_+)/\tau)}{\sum_i \exp(\text{sim}(q, k_i)/\tau)}$. Prove that as $\tau \to 0^+$, the gradient focuses almost exclusively on the **hardest negative** in the batch, whereas a large $\tau$ treats all negatives equally.
